eyebrow: The playbook's trigger and first two steps
code:
triggers.Microsoft_Sentinel_incident
  -> hands you: incident ARM ID, severity, title, entities

actions.Get_incident
  GET /Incidents/{id}
  runAfter: {}

actions.Add_comment_to_incident
  POST /Incidents/{id}/comments
  body: "Automated enrichment starting."
  runAfter: Get_incident Succeeded
caption: runAfter sequences actions -- each one waits on the ones it depends on.

eyebrow: Wiring the rule to the playbook
code:
# Sentinel -> Automation -> Automation rules -> + Create
# Trigger:    When incident is created
# Conditions: Severity is High OR Medium
#             AND Analytic rule name IN (sign-in/identity rules)
# Actions:    Run playbook -> "Enrich-And-Notify"
#
# First time you add it: grant "Microsoft Sentinel
# Automation Contributor" on the playbook's resource group
caption: Without that role grant, Sentinel's call to run the playbook is rejected.
